clauses.text: Master’s degree in Chemistry from a recognized University/Institute

The candidate should have work experience in SAP and e-office system and knowledge of Microsoft Word, Power Point, Excel etc Other Criteria: At least 01 outstanding rating in last three years excluding in year of superannuation
